issue.title: Add relation-label hide, one-off ||, and global rename to glossary:task-relation
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `glossary/task-relation.md` (plus a new `glossary/relation-label.md` strand)

Epic bob-cli-bj (Relation label vocabulary) shipped relation-label hide/unhide, the
one-off `||` capture syntax, and the global `bob relations rename`, but its auto
decision `memory_glossary = no` forbade the glossary edit inside the epic. Every phase
recorded the skipped change as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-cli-bj.1 #1, bj.3 #2, bj.5 #1,
bj.6 #1, bj.7 #1, bj.8 #1, bj.9 #1, bj.10 #1, and bj.11 #1 (the glossary:task-relation
sentence), and bj.2 #1 (a Relation label glossary entry). The label-catalog phase plan
also asked for a **Relation label** entry in `docs/reference/glossary.md`, but that page
is generated from the glossary memory web, so a hand edit would drift; it is absent
today (`grep -i "relation label" docs/reference/glossary.md` finds nothing).

Proposed change:

1. `glossary:task-relation`: add one sentence — a relation's label can be hidden from
   suggestions (Ctrl+D in the Mac card or Obsidian stage, `bob relations hide`, or a
   one-off `~note:id||label` capture) without changing any LINKS text, and renamed
   everywhere, `done/` included, with `bob relations rename` in one revertable commit.
2. Optionally add a `glossary:relation-label` strand (alias: relation) defining the
   optional text on a LINKS entry, its key (trim, collapse whitespace, strip one
   trailing `:`, lowercase), and linking `decisions:relation-label-hide-is-suggestions-only`
   and `decisions:relation-label-rename-rewrites-history`; contract source is
   `docs/task-relations.md` §16.
3. Run `sase memory init` and `just docs-gen` so `docs/reference/glossary.md` picks up
   the change, then `just docs-check`.

Closing requires Bryan's explicit permission for the memory edit.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add one sentence on hiding a relation label from suggestions (Ctrl+D, bob relations hide, one-off ||) and renaming it everywhere with bob relations rename; optionally add a glossary:relation-label strand; run sase memory init and just docs-gen.
